watching: The Iran war moved from threat to exchange: strikes resumed, Hormuz closed, a claimed hit on a Jordanian base, and a wedding struck at Sirik — the escalation now has a host-nation retaliation surface, not just a bilateral one.

Nuclear bargaining is running on three tracks at once — a Saudi enrichment deal disclosed in Washington, a Rosatom SMR draft for Iran signed mid-war, and the IAEA confirming Deir ez-Zor nineteen years late.

Four Vladivostok datelines carried Russian eastward-pivot stories — Arctic shipping, VTB's QR rails into Southeast Asia, industrial sensor fusion, the Iran reactor draft — which is one forum being read as four separate arcs.

AI liability is being drawn deliberately downstream of the model: the UK cyber bill spares vendors, Google keeps its ad exchange without divestiture, and a Texas surveillance audit was written by the tool it audits.
Uber appears twice on the same day from opposite ends — 3,300 head-office jobs cut in San Francisco, and an unwound exit from Nigeria and Uganda that left contractors with no wind-down.
coverageGaps: Latin America is absent except as an object of US action — the boat strikes and the Falklands review are both datelined Washington and London, with no bylines from the region itself.
Oceania recorded two articles, both Australian and both incidental (Bunbury dolphins, a Singapore-datelined carrier story); the Pacific Islands are again unrepresented.
Science ran ten articles and no multi-source story for a second consecutive day; the sourcing cluster cannot improve while a sixth of output is structurally single-outlet.
The metrics file lists Yahoo! Finance and Hindustan Times among science sources, which indicates the science tag is being applied to general-desk copy rather than specialist reporting.
Two datelines are not cities — "Amery Ice Shelf" and "Tekapo" — which breaks the mobile app's exact-match dateline strip that expects a city name.
